verdict.rationale: AFK is an AI-driven company-operations platform that connects to tools like Mercury, Gusto, Carta and Stripe, so exposing its workflows or connected-app actions as MCP tools is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or any endpoint for external agents to call AFK workflows. The probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose my workflows or connected app actions as MCP tools that an external agent can call
